C0673.title: Lsky Pro Image Host Modification Guide: Removing Upload Restrictions and Adding Native Video Support
C0673.summary: Lsky Pro is an open-source image hosting and cloud album system whose official documentation provides image upload, management, and external-link capabilities. If an operator bypasses format, size, or content limits and expands a normal image hosting service into arbitrary file storage or video distribution, it may create risks of copyright-content distribution, malicious file hosting, and resource abuse. The current references only support the system functionality background.

references.title: Lsky Pro (Lan Kong) source code repository — open-source project users fork to remove upload limits
Lsky Pro official documentation — natively image-only, modding enables video support
